The '''L.A.V.A. Suit''' was an [[Environment suit/Legends|enviro-suit]] designed to allow [[Geologist/Legends|geologists]] to safely gather readings from highly [[Volcano/Legends|volcanic]] areas. It came with heat shields, sensors, a [[Kolto/Legends|kolto]] application system, a drill, and a jump pack.<ref name="Encounter" />
